newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria 96 group operating profit up 5%.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria 96 group operating profit up 5%.

text.p: Bank Austria said on Sunday parent operating profit for 1996 rose five percent and that net profit would be a shade lower than the previous year's.

"I can present you with the following preliminary parent figures -- operating profit 5.1 billion schillings, that's up five percent, and net profit will be a trace below last year's," chief executive Gerhard Randa told a news conference.
Randa added he did not have exact figures on a group basis, but said they would show similar fluctuations.
In 1995, Bank Austria turned in an operating profit of 4.85 billion schillings and a net profit of 2.2 billion schillings. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
